summary_md: **AgentsWatch ([@AgentsWatch](https://x.com/AgentsWatch/status/2115336164941222211))** summarizes **HSC-Bench** (Li et al.) on agent handoffs: structured state beat a same-length recent transcript for 5 of 6 models on continuation score, while Kimi K2 fell 9.43 points on tool-state tasks.

referenced_urls.title: Benchmarking Task Takeover Across Agent Handoffs

relevance: Guidance on what to pass between agents at handoff.

media.description: Three panels of score-difference points with 95% CIs (task-level and task-family) for GPT-5.4, Sonnet 5, DeepSeek, Qwen 3.5+, Gemini FL and Kimi K2 under (a) Conversational State (n=205), (b) Tool State (n=386) and (c) File-work State (n=148).
